article.headline: Southern Miss secures 80-69 win against Nicholls State
article.description: — Anthony Igiede’s 16 points helped Southern Miss defeat Nicholls State 80-69 on Saturday.

keywords: Southern Miss Golden Eagles @ Nicholls Colonels
article.story: PENSACOLA, Fla. -- — Anthony Igiede’s 16 points helped Southern Miss defeat Nicholls State 80-69 on Saturday. Igiede shot 6 of 11 from the field, including 0 for 4 from 3-point range, and went 4 for 5 from the line for the Golden Eagles (4-3). Jalyke Gaines-Wyatt scored 16 points while going 4 of 11 from the floor, including 1 for 3 from 3-point range, and 7 for 8 from the line. Isaac Tavares shot 5 of 9 from the field and 3 for 7 from the line to finish with 14 points, while adding six rebounds. AJ Dent Jr. led the Colonels (2-4) in scoring, finishing with 18 points, two steals and two blocks. Christian Winborne added 14 points and two steals for Nicholls State. Sheridan Sharp also had 11 points, five assists and four steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
